ticket.title: Scaffold aerofoil-tracker with 64-shard striped RwLock table and AddressFilter
ticket.description: Scaffold crates/tracker with 64-shard striped parking_lot::RwLock hash map partitioned by ICAO address (ADR-0005). Implement AddressFilter trait for zero-allocation address lookup on decode path.
acceptance_criteria: aerofoil-tracker is added to workspace Cargo.toml with edition 2024 and MSRV 1.99
Tracker struct exposes 64 striped parking_lot::RwLock shards partitioned by address modulo 64
Tracker implements aerofoil_common::filter::AddressFilter with zero allocation
Unit and integration tests prove concurrent shard read/write operations and verify memory footprint
